notes: Sabotrack tasks got a big upgrade: every station now sits at a real thing (the organ, telescope, cauldron, slot machine, trading desk, lockers, vending machine, electrical board, studio desk, blackboard) and has 3 different missions with the same theme — you never know which one you'll get, and the third is HARD. All the minigames are redrawn as proper little scenes, and many work with the keyboard: Space to stop/tap/hold/pour/lock, arrows, number keys, piano keys (A W S E D…), Esc to close. Singing without a mic now gives you a note slider (C to C) to drag onto the right note.
